capabilities: Sync Markdown notes, Canvas boards, bases, and attachments with Google Drive
Collaborate live on Markdown and Canvas with presence and conflict merge
Resolve user, item, event, and drive mentions into clickable links
Publish event notes to Google Calendar, Discord, WhatsApp, and FlightClub
Curate and install a team plugin list from Obsidian's directory
disambiguation: Not a Markdown formatter; it is a team sync and collaboration client for FlightClub.
extras: Requires an approved FlightClub account; access is limited by role tiers. No telemetry or self-updating. Optional team plugin data.json presets are opt-in, strip secret-like keys, and create a local backup before applying.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a team's Google Drive folder, co-edit Markdown and Canvas in real time, or distribute a curated plugin list.
